title.en: Interpretation (Singapore Food Agency — Fees for Certificates for Export) Order 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Interpretation (Singapore Food Agency — Fees for Certificates for Export) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 12 November 2024.

3. This Order applies to any certificate issued by the Agency relating to any food or animal feed intended for export to a foreign country, attesting to matters in respect of which the foreign country requires certification before the food or animal feed may be imported into that foreign country from Singapore, except the following:
(a)any such certificate issued under the Wholesome Meat and Fish Act 1999, including any export health certificate issued under rule 8 of the Wholesome Meat and Fish (Import, Export and Transhipment) Rules (R 2);
(b)any such certificate issued under the Animals and Birds Act 1965, including —
(i)any certificate of freedom from disease issued under section 18 of that Act; and
(ii)any health certificate issued under rule 8 of the Animals and Birds (Live Fish) Rules 2011 (G.N. No. S 27/2011).
4. The fee specified in the second column of the Schedule is payable to the Agency for the issue of any certificate specified opposite in the first column.

THE SCHEDULE

1.Certificate that the food may be sold in Singapore and may be exported for human consumption
$17.11 per certificate
2.Certificate that —
(a)the food meets the requirements of the foreign country for fitness for human consumption; or
(b)after the import of the food into Singapore —
(i)the handling of the food in Singapore was in accordance with any requirement of Singapore or the foreign country for fitness for human consumption;
(ii)the food was stored in premises regulated by the Agency;
(iii)the food was not further processed, re‑packed or re‑labelled in Singapore; and
(iv)the packaging of the food did not change in Singapore
$20 per certificate
